# vecdnlb.com
> Vector database and NLP-focused site covering embeddings, semantic search, retrieval, and related AI engineering topics.

This site appears to center on practical information about vector databases, natural language processing, and modern AI retrieval workflows. The most useful pages for language models are likely article, guide, and category pages that organize content around embeddings, search, indexing, and application patterns.

## Main
- [Home](https://vecdnlb.com/): Main entry point for the site and access to recent vector database and NLP content.
- [Blog](https://vecdnlb.com/blog/): Central listing of published articles and technical posts.
- [About](https://vecdnlb.com/about/): Background information about the site, its purpose, and editorial focus.
- [Contact](https://vecdnlb.com/contact/): Contact page for inquiries related to the site and its content.

## Vector Databases
- [Vector Database](https://vecdnlb.com/category/vector-database/): Articles focused on vector database concepts, systems, and implementation considerations.
- [Embeddings](https://vecdnlb.com/category/embeddings/): Content about embedding models, vector representations, and usage patterns.
- [Indexing](https://vecdnlb.com/category/indexing/): Guides and posts about indexing strategies for vector search workloads.
- [Similarity Search](https://vecdnlb.com/category/similarity-search/): Coverage of nearest-neighbor retrieval and similarity-based search techniques.

## NLP
- [Natural Language Processing](https://vecdnlb.com/category/nlp/): NLP-focused articles covering text processing, modeling, and applied language systems.
- [Semantic Search](https://vecdnlb.com/category/semantic-search/): Content about semantic retrieval, ranking, and search relevance.
- [Text Embeddings](https://vecdnlb.com/category/text-embeddings/): Articles on generating and using text embeddings in applications.
- [Information Retrieval](https://vecdnlb.com/category/information-retrieval/): Material on retrieval pipelines, ranking, and search system design.

## AI Engineering
- [Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://vecdnlb.com/category/rag/): Posts about RAG architectures, retrieval pipelines, and LLM application design.
- [LLM Applications](https://vecdnlb.com/category/llm-applications/): Practical content on building applications with large language models.
- [Machine Learning](https://vecdnlb.com/category/machine-learning/): Broader machine learning articles relevant to vector and NLP systems.
- [AI Tools](https://vecdnlb.com/category/ai-tools/): Coverage of tools and platforms used in AI development workflows.

## Tutorials
- [Guides](https://vecdnlb.com/category/guides/): Step-by-step guides for implementing vector and NLP techniques.
- [Tutorials](https://vecdnlb.com/category/tutorials/): Hands-on tutorials for search, embeddings, and AI application development.
- [How-To Articles](https://vecdnlb.com/category/how-to/): Practical how-to content for common engineering tasks.
- [Best Practices](https://vecdnlb.com/category/best-practices/): Recommendations and implementation guidance for production systems.

## Topics
- [ANN Search](https://vecdnlb.com/category/ann-search/): Content about approximate nearest neighbor algorithms and tradeoffs.
- [Hybrid Search](https://vecdnlb.com/category/hybrid-search/): Articles on combining lexical and vector retrieval methods.
- [Metadata Filtering](https://vecdnlb.com/category/metadata-filtering/): Guidance on filtering and structured constraints in vector search.
- [Evaluation](https://vecdnlb.com/category/evaluation/): Posts about measuring retrieval quality and system performance.

## Archive
- [All Categories](https://vecdnlb.com/categories/): Overview of content categories across the site.
- [All Tags](https://vecdnlb.com/tags/): Tag index for browsing topics and related articles.
- [Archives](https://vecdnlb.com/archives/): Chronological archive of published content.
- [Sitemap](https://vecdnlb.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for discovering site URLs and content structure.
